title: Brick stables behind 2031 and 2033 Prairie
items: The stables behind 2031 and 2033 Prairie now stand on the alley as a matched pair of two-storey brick buildings, each about 14.7 m deep, sharing a fire wall on their lot line and closed by another at their far ends, as the 1911 fire-insurance map draws them.
Each has a carriage door and a loft hatch on the alley, the one window the map marks there, and a paved yard and walk back to its house's rear wing.
